identification_strategy: One-line: RDD — treatment = extended UI benefits, control = regular UI benefits; shock/instrument/cutoff = exact age
conclusion_detail: The effective moral hazard effect of UI extensions is significantly lower in recessions than in booms.
main_effect: nonemployment of about 0.1 months for each additional month of potential UI benefit duration
key_robustness: considering variation by year or year-by-industry
notes: The study uses a sharp regression discontinuity design which helps in identifying causal effects, but the confidence is not 1.0 due to potential unobserved factors affecting the results.
